AcceptabilityEstimate.description:
How often an event occurred in the draws, with its exact (Clopper-Pearson) interval; or,
under exact enumeration, its probability with no count and no interval.
AcceptabilityEstimate.title: AcceptabilityEstimate

AhpAnalysisRecord.description: AHP: the priorities and every matrix's consistency; no value-model context.
AhpAnalysisRecord.title: AhpAnalysisRecord

AhpResult.description:
AHP priorities from pairwise judgements. ``ranking`` holds the overall priorities;
``weight_profile_id`` and ``scenario_id`` are None, because AHP reads neither.

label.const: AHP priorities under these pairwise judgements: shares of the goal that sum to one, not MAVT values or swing weights
label.default: AHP priorities under these pairwise judgements: shares of the goal that sum to one, not MAVT values or swing weights
label.title: Label

AhpResult.title: AhpResult

AhpTriad.description: The most inconsistent triple of a matrix by Koczkodaj's index; a hint, never applied.
AhpTriad.title: AhpTriad

AlternativeFlows.description: One alternative's outranking flows, each normalised by n - 1.
AlternativeFlows.title: AlternativeFlows

AlternativeJudgements.description: The alternatives judged against each other on one leaf criterion.
AlternativeJudgements.title: AlternativeJudgements

AnalysisSnapshot.description: One requested configuration; an unavailable analysis is recorded, never dropped.
AnalysisSnapshot.title: AnalysisSnapshot

AnchorMode.description:
Where the 0-and-1 anchors of a *linear* value function come from.

FIXED: ``lower``/``upper`` are stated by the user and never depend on the alternatives.
LOCAL: anchors are the min/max over the alternatives currently in the project. This is an
       explicit, recorded choice because adding an alternative can then change every
       existing alternative's score.
AnchorMode.title: AnchorMode

ArtifactAnchor.description:
Where an artifact's compiled project sits: the record's project, or the original project
of another artifact in the record (a calculation compiled on top of compiled evidence).
ArtifactAnchor.title: ArtifactAnchor

AuditSample.description:
Alternatives sorted below a cut-off, chosen for manual review of possible false negatives.

It estimates nothing and never changes a class.
AuditSample.title: AuditSample

BoundRequirement.description: A numeric leaf's measurement must lie within the stated limits, in the leaf's unit.
BoundRequirement.title: BoundRequirement

CategoricalDistribution.description: Listed labels of a labelled scale with their probabilities.
CategoricalDistribution.title: CategoricalDistribution

CellUncertainty.description: One measurement's distribution, used instead of its entered value in SMAA runs.
CellUncertainty.title: CellUncertainty

ClassBand.description: One ordered class as a band on the overall value scale.
ClassBand.title: ClassBand

CriteriaJudgements.description: The children of one criterion (``None``: the top level) judged against each other.
CriteriaJudgements.title: CriteriaJudgements

CriterionExplanation.description: One criterion's part in a pair ordered differently, in each method's own units.
CriterionExplanation.title: CriterionExplanation

DecisionDetails.description:
What the decision owner states for a version-2 record. ``alternatives_considered`` is a
declaration only: every recorded analysis still uses all of the project's alternatives.
DecisionDetails.title: DecisionDetails

DerivedCompilation.description: Reproducible static copy with the exact original assumptions and review context.
DerivedCompilation.title: DerivedCompilation

DirectRatingValueFunction.description: The measurement *is* a rating on [min_rating, max_rating], rescaled linearly to [0, 1].
DirectRatingValueFunction.title: DirectRatingValueFunction

DiscreteDistribution.description: Listed numeric values with their probabilities.
DiscreteDistribution.title: DiscreteDistribution

Domain.description: The numeric interval over which a value function is defined, and where it came from.
Domain.title: Domain

EvidenceCompilation.description:
The exact review history, the preview compiled from it and the separate project copy.

The effective dossier is not stored: replaying ``workspace`` derives it from the original
proposals and appended reviews, so no independently editable current state can drift.
EvidenceCompilation.title: EvidenceCompilation

ExternalProposals.description: Original intake plus its exact source and separate, replayable review events.
ExternalProposals.title: ExternalProposals

FactorDistribution.description: One factor's marginal, in the factor's own unit; no conversion or inference.
FactorDistribution.title: FactorDistribution

label.const: feasibility: each requirement is tested on its own measurement; no score offsets a failure
label.default: feasibility: each requirement is tested on its own measurement; no score offsets a failure
label.title: Label

GroupUncertainty.description:
Weight uncertainty in one sibling group; a group without an entry keeps its ratings.

``unknown``: local weights uniform on the group's simplex, Dirichlet(1, ..., 1).
``rating_intervals``: each child's raw swing rating uniform on its stated [lower, upper], then
normalised within the group.
GroupUncertainty.title: GroupUncertainty

InputToCheck.description: The leading alternative's rank-1 frequency with one input in its upper and lower half.
InputToCheck.title: InputToCheck

Issue.description: A validation finding or an analysis diagnostic.
Issue.title: Issue

LabelsRequirement.description: A labelled leaf's measurement must be one of the allowed labels.
LabelsRequirement.title: LabelsRequirement

LinearPreferenceFunction.description: No preference up to q, linear between q and p, full preference from p.
LinearPreferenceFunction.title: LinearPreferenceFunction

LinearValueFunction.description: v(x) = (x-L)/(U-L) (increasing) or (U-x)/(U-L) (decreasing); L, U come from the scale.
LinearValueFunction.title: LinearValueFunction

MavtSortingResult.description: MAVT values sorted into ordered classes by fixed numeric boundaries.
MavtSortingResult.title: MavtSortingResult

MeasurementTrace.description: Which retained artifact set each entered measurement, and what it replaced.
MeasurementTrace.title: MeasurementTrace

OutrankingExplanation.description:
Why PROMETHEE II and MAVT order alternatives differently. The only cross-method operation
is comparing orders; no number adds, averages or subtracts a value and a flow.
OutrankingExplanation.title: OutrankingExplanation

PairExplanation.description:
A pair the two methods order differently. ``alternative_a`` is the one MAVT places higher
(or, when MAVT ties them, the one PROMETHEE II places lower).
PairExplanation.title: PairExplanation

PairwiseJudgement.description: ``row`` is ``value`` times as important, or preferred, as ``column`` (1 <= value <= 9).
PairwiseJudgement.title: PairwiseJudgement

PartialOrderPair.description: One unordered pair under PROMETHEE I. For a preference, ``alternative_a`` is preferred.
PartialOrderPair.title: PartialOrderPair

Performance.description: One cell of the performance table: how an alternative performs on a leaf criterion.
Performance.title: Performance

PiecewiseLinearValueFunction.description: Interpolates linearly between ordered (x, value) points; domain = [x_first, x_last].
PiecewiseLinearValueFunction.title: PiecewiseLinearValueFunction

ProjectCopyReceipt.description:
Issued when an import stores a project under a new ID because the original ID exists.

``new_project_id`` means exactly one change: ``id`` was replaced. Every other field, and
therefore every measurement and judgement, is byte-identical in canonical JSON.
ProjectCopyReceipt.title: ProjectCopyReceipt

PrometheeAnalysisRecord.description: PROMETHEE II: the flows, the partial order and the explanation; no value-model context.
PrometheeAnalysisRecord.title: PrometheeAnalysisRecord

PrometheeCriterion.description: PROMETHEE's inputs for one leaf; thresholds are in its units (its codes when labelled).
PrometheeCriterion.title: PrometheeCriterion

PrometheeCriterionUsed.description: One leaf's PROMETHEE inputs as used: the stated weight and its normalised share.
PrometheeCriterionUsed.title: PrometheeCriterionUsed

PrometheeResult.description:
PROMETHEE II net flows and the PROMETHEE I partial order. ``ranking`` holds the PROMETHEE II
order and its ``value`` is the net flow, never a preference value. ``weight_profile_id`` and
``scenario_id`` are those of the explanation's MAVT side; PROMETHEE's inputs ignore them.

label.const: net outranking flows: these compare the alternatives with one another and are not preference values
label.default: net outranking flows: these compare the alternatives with one another and are not preference values
label.title: Label

PrometheeResult.title: PrometheeResult

QualitativeValueFunction.description: Explicit label -> preference value mapping. Spacing is a judgement, never assumed.
QualitativeValueFunction.title: QualitativeValueFunction

QuantileGroup.description:
Factors that share one uniform draw through their own quantile functions.

This states perfectly shared quantiles, not a correlation coefficient or covariance.
QuantileGroup.title: QuantileGroup

RankComparison.description: Ranks only: a value and a flow never share a column.
RankComparison.title: RankComparison

Scenario.description: A named variation of the base model: another weight profile and/or other value functions.
Scenario.title: Scenario

SharedDraw.description: Cells from one source: they use one common uniform draw through their own quantiles.
SharedDraw.title: SharedDraw

SmaaAnalysisRecord.description: SMAA-2: the acceptabilities with their full provenance; no value-model context.
SmaaAnalysisRecord.title: SmaaAnalysisRecord

SmaaResult.description:
SMAA-2 acceptabilities. ``ranking`` is MAVT's reference ranking at the entered values and
the profile's ratings; the acceptabilities never enter it.

inputs_to_check_label.const: heuristic: association in these draws, not causation or value of information
inputs_to_check_label.default: heuristic: association in these draws, not causation or value of information
inputs_to_check_label.title: Inputs To Check Label

SmaaResult.title: SmaaResult

SortingAnalysisRecord.description: Value-based sorting: the sorted result and the value-model context its MAVT panels read.
SortingAnalysisRecord.title: SortingAnalysisRecord

SortingAudit.description: A seed-keyed sample of alternatives sorted below ``below_class_id``, for manual review.
SortingAudit.title: SortingAudit

SortingClass.description:
One ordered class. ``lower_boundary`` is the overall value needed to enter it.

The lowest class has no boundary: it takes every remaining value.
SortingClass.title: SortingClass

UShapeFunction.description: No preference up to the indifference threshold q, full preference beyond it.
UShapeFunction.title: UShapeFunction

UsualFunction.description: Any positive difference is full preference.
UsualFunction.title: UsualFunction

VShapeFunction.description: Preference grows linearly from 0 to full at the preference threshold p.
VShapeFunction.title: VShapeFunction

WeightProfile.description:
Raw swing ratings, one per criterion node, relative to that node's siblings.

A rating expresses the importance of the swing from worst to best *over the scale range
in use* - not abstract importance. Ratings need not sum to anything; they are normalised
within each sibling group. An only child needs no rating (its local weight is 1).
WeightProfile.title: WeightProfile
